analysis:
All changes are in test-only fixtures under provider-swift/Tests/ClusterInstalledSessionChecks. InstalledFixture.swift (lines 25, 61, 80) adds an optional prefillSchedule parameter. The fabricated runtime capability then advertises supportedPrefillSchedules as [.serial] by default, or allCases when a schedule is given. It also writes prefillSchedule into the setup object. InstalledSessionCheck.swift (patch hunk at 981-989) extends the expected Gemma environment map in adaptersOnTheInstalledPath with DistributedInstalledPlan.batchLanesSwitch set to gemma4PipelineBatchLanes. This is an assertion about the owner-built native rank environment, not a production code change.

No production sources are in this batch, so this does not alter the coordinator-to-provider wire contract, attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011), the prefix-cache SSD tier (T-041) or key handling. The existing key-isolation checks in prefixSSDKeyNeverInChildEnvironment (base lines 365-417) are unchanged. The fixture keys and secrets are synthetic. The fixture's fixtureArtifacts mapping remains described as check-builds-only, and its source is not supplied here.

Open integration questions: whether the production code that parses prefillSchedule and batch lanes (outside this batch) keeps the environment allowlist bounded and does not widen what a rank inherits. This is only a test-expectation change and not evidence of a regression. The base excerpt of InstalledSessionCheck.swift is truncated at line 664, so the remainder of the file was not reviewed beyond the changed hunk.
